description: This file defines the SaveEmploymentStatusController class, which is responsible for handling requests related to saving employment status information within the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract Vue controller and prepares Vue components based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveEmploymentStatusController
classes.description: Controller class handling the save operation for employment status, with logic to set up Vue components depending on whether an employment status ID is provided in the request.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering based on the request. If an 'id' attribute is present, it sets up an edit component with the ID; otherwise, it sets up a save component.
